prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Mora Fenhook. Character visual motifs: elderly marsh boatwoman beneath a wide oilcloth hood, a segmented oar and a floating narrow spirit skiff; completely remove hooked chains and warden cage.
TOP LEFT: Crossing Fees. Ability concept: when an allied hero safely finishes a Mora-established route, Mora accrues Fare (max 2), each reducing the next route setup delay by 0.15 s. There is no reward for trapping or dragging enemies.
TOP RIGHT: Mooring Post. Ability concept: plants a small lit mooring within 115 GU. Posts have 2 HP, last 7 s, and are legal only on traversable ground. First post is the departure; second is the arrival. Max one linked pair.
BOTTOM LEFT: Departing Bell. Ability concept: if two posts exist and a collision-valid traversable path joins them, summons a 2.3 s ferry that follows that path at fixed speed. Allies and enemies **voluntarily board** within 20 GU using a public interaction or AI accepted decision; a boarded unit cannot attack for the trip but may disembark at legal path checkpoints. No forced motion from hard CC.
BOTTOM RIGHT: The Last Crossing. Ability concept: temporarily creates two public **emergency moorings** at legal points near Mora, then dispatches a second larger ferry allowing up to two passengers for one journey. It gives passengers a small shield **on arrival**, not invulnerability while traveling; destroying arrival post stops the ferry at its nearest legal earlier dock.
